verses.ar: حِكْمَةُ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ تَبْنِي بَيْتَهَا، وَٱلْحَمَاقَةُ تَهْدِمُهُ بِيَدِهَا.
verses.kjv: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.web: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

verses.ar: اَلسَّالِكُ بِٱسْتِقَامَتِهِ يَتَّقِي ٱلرَّبَّ، وَٱلْمُعَوِّجُ طُرُقَهُ يَحْتَقِرُهُ.
verses.kjv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but [he that is] perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.web: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

verses.ar: فِي فَمِ ٱلْجَاهِلِ قَضِيبٌ لِكِبْرِيَائِهِ، أَمَّا شِفَاهُ ٱلْحُكَمَاءِ فَتَحْفَظُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: In the mouth of the foolish [is] a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.web: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

verses.ar: حَيْثُ لَا بَقَرٌ فَٱلْمَعْلَفُ فَارِغٌ، وَكَثْرَةُ ٱلْغَلَّةِ بِقُوَّةِ ٱلثَّوْرِ.
verses.kjv: Where no oxen [are], the crib [is] clean: but much increase [is] by the strength of the ox.
verses.web: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

verses.ar: اَلشَّاهِدُ ٱلْأَمِينُ لَنْ يَكْذِبَ، وَٱلشَّاهِدُ ٱلزُّورُ يَتَفَوَّهُ بِٱلْأَكَاذِيبِ.
verses.kjv: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
verses.web: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

verses.ar: اَلْمُسْتَهْزِئُ يَطْلُبُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَلَا يَجِدُهَا، وَٱلْمَعْرِفَةُ هَيِّنَةٌ لِلْفَهِيمِ.
verses.kjv: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and [findeth it] not: but knowledge [is] easy unto him that understandeth.
verses.web: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

verses.ar: اِذْهَبْ مِنْ قُدَّامِ رَجُلٍ جَاهِلٍ إِذْ لَا تَشْعُرُ بِشَفَتَيْ مَعْرِفَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not [in him] the lips of knowledge.
verses.web: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

verses.ar: حِكْمَةُ ٱلذَّكِيِّ فَهْمُ طَرِيقِهِ، وَغَبَاوَةُ ٱلْجُهَّالِ غِشٌّ.
verses.kjv: The wisdom of the prudent [is] to understand his way: but the folly of fools [is] deceit.
verses.web: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

verses.ar: اَلْجُهَّالُ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ بِٱلْإِثْمِ، وَبَيْنَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ رِضًى.
verses.kjv: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous [there is] favour.
verses.web: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

verses.ar: اَلْقَلْبُ يَعْرِفُ مَرَارَةَ نَفْسِهِ، وَبِفَرَحِهِ لَا يُشَارِكُهُ غَرِيبٌ.
verses.kjv: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
verses.web: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

verses.ar: بَيْتُ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ يُخْرَبُ، وَخَيْمَةُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ تُزْهِرُ.
verses.kjv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
verses.web: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

verses.ar: تُوجَدُ طَرِيقٌ تَظْهَرُ لِلْإِنْسَانِ مُسْتَقِيمَةً، وَعَاقِبَتُهَا طُرُقُ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof [are] the ways of death.
verses.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا فِي ٱلضِّحِكِ يَكْتَئِبُ ٱلْقَلْبُ، وَعَاقِبَةُ ٱلْفَرَحِ حُزْنٌ.
verses.kjv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth [is] heaviness.
verses.web: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

verses.ar: اَلْمُرْتَدُّ فِي ٱلْقَلْبِ يَشْبَعُ مِنْ طُرُقِهِ، وَٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلصَّالِحُ مِمَّا عِنْدَهُ.
verses.kjv: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man [shall be satisfied] from himself.
verses.web: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

verses.ar: اَلْغَبِيُّ يُصَدِّقُ كُلَّ كَلِمَةٍ، وَٱلذَّكِيُّ يَنْتَبِهُ إِلَى خَطَوَاتِهِ.
verses.kjv: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent [man] looketh well to his going.
verses.web: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

verses.ar: اَلْحَكِيمُ يَخْشَى وَيَحِيدُ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ، وَٱلْجَاهِلُ يَتَصَلَّفُ وَيَثِقُ.
verses.kjv: A wise [man] feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
verses.web: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

verses.ar: اَلسَّرِيعُ ٱلْغَضَبِ يَعْمَلُ بِٱلْحَمَقِ، وَذُو ٱلْمَكَايِدِ يُشْنَأُ.
verses.kjv: [He that is] soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.web: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

verses.ar: اَلْأَغْبِيَاءُ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْحَمَاقَةَ، وَٱلْأَذْكِيَاءُ يُتَوَّجُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ.
verses.kjv: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.web: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

verses.ar: ٱلْأَشْرَارُ يَنْحَنُونَ أَمَامَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ، وَٱلْأَثَمَةُ لَدَى أَبْوَابِ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ.
verses.kjv: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.web: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا مِنْ قَرِيبِهِ يُبْغَضُ ٱلْفَقِيرُ، وَمُحِبُّو ٱلْغَنِيِّ كَثِيرُونَ.
verses.kjv: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich [hath] many friends.
verses.web: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَحْتَقِرُ قَرِيبَهُ يُخْطِئُ، وَمَنْ يَرْحَمُ ٱلْمَسَاكِينَ فَطُوبَى لَهُ.
verses.kjv: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy [is] he.
verses.web: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

verses.ar: أَمَا يَضِلُّ مُخْتَرِعُو ٱلشَّرِّ؟ أَمَّا ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَٱلْحَقُّ فَيَهْدِيَانِ مُخْتَرِعِي ٱلْخَيْرِ.
verses.kjv: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth [shall be] to them that devise good.
verses.web: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

verses.ar: فِي كُلِّ تَعَبٍ مَنْفَعَةٌ، وَكَلَامُ ٱلشَّفَتَيْنِ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَى ٱلْفَقْرِ.
verses.kjv: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips [tendeth] only to penury.
verses.web: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

verses.ar: تَاجُ ٱلْحُكَمَاءِ غِنَاهُمْ. تَقَدُّمُ ٱلْجُهَّالِ حَمَاقَةٌ.
verses.kjv: The crown of the wise [is] their riches: [but] the foolishness of fools [is] folly.
verses.web: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

verses.ar: اَلشَّاهِدُ ٱلْأَمِينُ مُنَجِّي ٱلنُّفُوسِ، وَمَنْ يَتَفَوَّهُ بِٱلْأَكَاذِيبِ فَغِشٌّ.
verses.kjv: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful [witness] speaketh lies.
verses.web: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

verses.ar: فِي مَخَافَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ ثِقَةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ، وَيَكُونُ لِبَنِيهِ مَلْجَأٌ.
verses.kjv: In the fear of the LORD [is] strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.web: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

verses.ar: مَخَافَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ يَنْبُوعُ حَيَاةٍ لِلْحَيَدَانِ عَنْ أَشْرَاكِ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD [is] a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

verses.ar: فِي كَثْرَةِ ٱلشَّعْبِ زِينَةُ ٱلْمَلِكِ، وَفِي عَدَمِ ٱلْقَوْمِ هَلَاكُ ٱلْأَمِيرِ.
verses.kjv: In the multitude of people [is] the king’s honour: but in the want of people [is] the destruction of the prince.
verses.web: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

verses.ar: بَطِيءُ ٱلْغَضَبِ كَثِيرُ ٱلْفَهْمِ، وَقَصِيرُ ٱلرُّوحِ مُعَلِّي ٱلْحَمَقِ.
verses.kjv: [He that is] slow to wrath [is] of great understanding: but [he that is] hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.web: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

verses.ar: حَيَاةُ ٱلْجَسَدِ هُدُوءُ ٱلْقَلْبِ، وَنَخْرُ ٱلْعِظَامِ ٱلْحَسَدُ.
verses.kjv: A sound heart [is] the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
verses.web: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

verses.ar: ظَالِمُ ٱلْفَقِيرِ يُعَيِّرُ خَالِقَهُ، وَيُمَجِّدُهُ رَاحِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ.
verses.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
verses.web: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

verses.ar: اَلشِّرِّيرُ يُطْرَدُ بِشَرِّهِ، أَمَّا ٱلصِّدِّيقُ فَوَاثِقٌ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ.
verses.kjv: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
verses.web: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

verses.ar: فِي قَلْبِ ٱلْفَهِيمِ تَسْتَقِرُّ ٱلْحِكْمَةُ، وَمَا فِي دَاخِلِ ٱلْجُهَّالِ يُعْرَفُ.
verses.kjv: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but [that which is] in the midst of fools is made known.
verses.web: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

verses.ar: اَلْبِرُّ يَرْفَعُ شَأْنَ ٱلْأُمَّةِ، وَعَارُ ٱلشُّعُوبِ ٱلْخَطِيَّةُ.
verses.kjv: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin [is] a reproach to any people.
verses.web: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

verses.ar: رِضْوَانُ ٱلْمَلِكِ عَلَى ٱلْعَبْدِ ٱلْفَطِنِ، وَسَخَطُهُ يَكُونُ عَلَى ٱلْمُخْزِي.
verses.kjv: The king’s favour [is] toward a wise servant: but his wrath is [against] him that causeth shame.
verses.web: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
